task.title: Add a --json flag to widget list
task.description: In the repository ${repo} (GitHub: https://github.com/eval/widget), add a `--json` flag to `widget list` that prints the widgets as a JSON array. The text output without the flag stays as it is.

artifact:
## How it works

`widget list --json` prints the widget list as one JSON array on standard output; without the flag the output stays as it is.

## Steps

1. Add a failing test in `test_widget.py` for `list_widgets(as_json=True)`.
2. Add the `as_json` parameter to `list_widgets` and the `--json` flag to the `list` subcommand.
3. Run `python3 -m unittest`.

## Verification

`python3 -m unittest` from the repository root passes, including the new test.

## Limitations

Only `list` gets the flag. A widget name that is not valid UTF-8 is not expected.
